title: Google Marketing Tools Support & Customer Service - Google Ads

facts.fact: The Google Ads support page states that multiple campaigns can be created in the same account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: Google Ads is a pay-per-click advertising platform, so the advertiser only pays when someone clicks on the ad.
facts.quote: Google Ads is a pay-per-click advertising platform, meaning that you only pay when someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: According to Google, the cost of Google Ads ads depends on industry, target audience, and the keywords chosen.
facts.quote: The cost of your ads will depend on a number of factors, including your industry, your target audience, and the keywords you choose.

facts.fact: According to Google, creating a Merchant Center account and showing products on Google is free of cost.
facts.quote: Creating a Merchant Center account and showing your products on Google is free of cost.

facts.fact: Google states that with Performance Max campaigns in Merchant Center, the advertiser will never pay more than its monthly budget cap.
facts.quote: With our Performance Max campaigns, you choose the goals you want to achieve, and you’ll never pay more than your monthly budget cap.

facts.fact: Google describes Merchant Center as a free tool that helps retailers add product information so their products can appear across Google surfaces.
facts.quote: Merchant Center is a free tool that enables retailers to add product information and data so that their products can appear across Google surfaces.

facts.fact: Google states that it does not ship products; customers visit the merchant's website and complete checkout there, and the merchant decides how to ship.
facts.quote: No, Google only helps customers find your products and your store. When they are interested in buying from you, they visit your website and go through your checkout process

facts.fact: To set up a Google Ads account, the steps are: enter business information such as website URL, choose campaign goals, upload creative assets, set a budget, and enter a payment method.
facts.quote: choose your campaign goals, upload your creative assets and set your budget. Finally, enter your payment method.

facts.fact: Merchant Center is available to retailers that sell products through a website, in a physical store, or both.
facts.quote: You need to be a retailer selling products through a website, in a physical store, or both.

facts.fact: Google states that Merchant Center products can appear across Google Search, Maps, YouTube, and other surfaces once they are added and confirmed as eligible.
facts.quote: Once your products are added and confirmed as eligible, they can show up across different Google surfaces, such as Google Search, Google Maps, YouTube

facts.fact: Google states that Performance Max is a paid advertising campaign where the advertiser stays in control of its budget and only pays when someone engages with the ad.
facts.quote: You stay in full control of your budget and only pay when someone engages with your ad.

facts.fact: Google describes Performance Max as a goal-based campaign type that gives access to all Google Ads inventory from a single campaign, spanning Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, and Maps.
facts.quote: Performance Max is a goal-based campaign type that helps you access all of Google Ads inventory from a single campaign.

facts.fact: Within Google Merchant Center, Performance Max campaigns optimize for online sales, while campaigns managed in Google Ads can optimize to one or more goals such as online and in-store conversions.
facts.quote: In Google Merchant Center, Performance Max campaigns optimize for online sales.

facts.fact: Google states that a Business Profile on Google is free to create and list a business.
facts.quote: Creating a Business Profile and listing your business on Google is free of cost.

facts.fact: Google states that most businesses verify profile ownership via phone, SMS, or a postcard mailed to the business address.
facts.quote: Most businesses verify their profile ownership via phone, SMS, or by requesting and receiving a postcard to their address from Google.

facts.fact: Google states that a business without a physical storefront can still have a Business Profile if it makes in-person contact with customers, such as service-area businesses that visit or deliver to customers.
facts.quote: Yes, you can have a profile if your business doesn’t have a physical address as long as you make in-person contact with customers.

facts.fact: Google states that responses to reviews appear below the customer's review under the label 'Response from the owner'.
facts.quote: your response appears below the customer’s review on Google Search and Maps under the label “Response from the owner”.

facts.fact: Google Analytics is free of charge, and Google also offers a paid version called Google Analytics 360 that has higher data limits and more advanced support options.
facts.quote: Google Analytics is free of charge. Google also offers a paid version called Google Analytics 360, which offers higher data limits and more advanced support options.

facts.fact: A Google Analytics account can have up to 100 accounts per user, and each account can contain up to 2,000 properties.
facts.quote: You can have one or more Analytics accounts (up to a 100). Each account can contain up to 2,000 properties.

facts.fact: Universal Analytics was the default property type for websites prior to October 14, 2020 and is no longer available.
facts.quote: This was the default property type for websites prior to October 14, 2020 and is no longer available.

facts.fact: Business Profile has replaced Google My Business, Google Places for Business, Google Listings, and Google+ Business Pages.
facts.quote: Business Profile has replaced Google My Business, Google Places for Business, Google Listings, and Google+ Business Pages.

facts.fact: YouTube Ads can work for almost any budget, and the advertiser controls how much is spent; accounts can be set to bill automatically or manually.
facts.quote: YouTube Ads can work for almost any budget, and how much you spend is always up to you. You also have the option to set your account to bill automatically or manually.

facts.fact: Ads pricing for YouTube Ads depends on the ad format chosen.
facts.quote: Ads pricing depends on the format you choose.

facts.fact: Google Analytics 4 is the default for new accounts; creating a new Google Analytics account today produces a Google Analytics 4 property.
facts.quote: If you create a new Google Analytics account today, it will be a Google Analytics 4 property.

facts.fact: Video promotions in YouTube Studio are available for channels that meet the conditions for Advanced features on YouTube and have more than 1,000 subscribers.
facts.quote: Video promotions are currently available for all channels which meet conditions for Advanced features on YT and have >1k subs.

facts.fact: Enabling a channel's first live stream may take up to 24 hours, after which live streams can start instantly.
facts.quote: Enabling your first live stream may take up to 24 hours. Once enabled, you can live stream instantly.

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers must upload their video ad to a YouTube channel before setting up a YouTube Ads campaign.
facts.quote: Yes, you’ll need to upload your video ad to your YouTube channel before you set up a campaign.

facts.fact: Promotions in YouTube Studio support only in-feed video ads; in-stream ads are not supported, and users must engage with the ad to reach the watch page or subscribe.
facts.quote: Only in-feed video ads are supported. In-stream ads are not supported. Users need to engage with the ad in order to reach the watch page or subscribe.

facts.fact: Google says that when a YouTube Ads campaign is started, advertisers get access to free tools to measure campaign performance.
facts.quote: When you start a campaign, you’ll get access to free tools that can help you measure how it’s doing.

facts.fact: Google states that advertisers can choose the people who see a YouTube ad based on age, location, interests, and more.
facts.quote: you’ll choose the people you want to see your ad based on age, location, interests, and more.
